description: Byte-identical copies of avd-assess's method (contract C20: method.json and index.json) and its PowerShell bundle verifier, from release `release` (docs/distribution-spec.md there, section 9). The assess run (lib/AvdAssess.psm1) reads only these copies; nothing is fetched at run time, so the copies here are the only source and the run never needs the network or assess.avd-ops.dev. Each must match the file at commit; `manifest` is the SHA-256 of the release's datapackage.json, vendored beside them, which pins every file in the release (tests/Assess.Tests.ps1 checks the hashes and runs the verifier). Update the files, datapackage.json, commit, release, manifest and the hashes in one PR, after checking the release's attestation.
